optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Credit Risk Data Scientist, Retail Lending

professionalSummary.text: Develops credit-scoring models in Python with documented methodology.
professionalSummary.witness: Built the reject-inference dataset in SQL and the variable-binning code in Python for the 2023 personal-loan application scorecard, working under the lead modeller.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepares development documentation for independent model validation.
experienceHighlights.witness: Drafted the data-preparation and variable-selection chapters of the scorecard's development document for the independent validation team, and answered the validators' data queries.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Has owned a credit model through approval as the accountable developer presenting to the model risk committee.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Described by the head of credit risk, at a team meeting, as 'the real owner of the personal-loan scorecard' who had 'carried the model through committee single-handed'.

skills.text: Monitors model performance (population stability, Gini) and reports drift.
skills.witness: Produced the monthly monitoring pack for the existing credit-card scorecard (population stability index, Gini by vintage, override rates) and flagged drift to the model owner with the vintage charts attached.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in developing credit-scoring models, preparing documentation, owning a model through approval, and monitoring performance. They do not establish the candidate's ability to work with SQL on loan-level datasets.

decisionBoundary.statement: The materials provide sufficient evidence to support some requirements but lack evidence for others. A qualified human review is required to make a final decision.
